prompt_pipeline.note: All 10 fixed held-out prompts survived the verify-dataset gate.

published_checkpoint_layout.note: Published through tools/clean_moshi.py with --remove_modules_for_user_stream, so the user stream is modelled as input but not generated.

blockers.cause: MoshiForConditionalGeneration.step samples 1 text + dep_q(8) audio codebooks but asserts num_codebooks = 1 + n_q = 17. This repository's generation path assumes dep_q == n_q, which holds for finetuning checkpoints that model the user stream, not for the published inference-format checkpoints.
blockers.impact: No baseline continuation audio was produced for either stage.

blockers.cause: Scores are worse than a uniform distribution over text_card=32000, so the reconstruction does not measure persona preference. The reconstruction conditions every audio codebook on zero_token_id for the whole sequence, which is a state the model never sees as input during training; zero_token_id is used as a loss ignore_index and as post-sequence padding, not as audio conditioning. The text tokenizer is not the problem: README lines 99-105 confirm J-Moshi uses rinna/japanese-gpt2-medium spiece.model, which is what the run used.
blockers.impact: The 10-pair persona baseline cannot be compared against the past Stage 2 +11.86 / Stage 3 +12.26 figures, nor used as a forward baseline.
